title: pithecoctenium callistegioides
intro: Pithecoctenium callistegioides, commonly known as "Cueru-cueru" in some regions, is a plant species native to Central and South America, characterized by its unique, climbing habit and its medicinal properties. The plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Pithecoctenium callistegioides include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
